items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, November 11, 2017 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: James Moody said a funny thing about that song

ctx.x: There I go again. Pretty baby, you are the soul that stops my control. Yeah.
James Moody said a funny thing about that song, that the reason he played the intro the way he did is cause he was playing it on alto when he normally played it on tenor or something.
Was it a borrowed horn or something?
